news.title: David Awschalom wins global Breakthrough of the Year award for interdisciplinary work in molecular and protein qubits
news.summary_en: Award by Berlin-based Falling Walls Foundation honors high-risk, multi-field leap across quantum, biology, and chemistry

news.title: Helium lifts new quantum computing concept
news.summary_en: Breakthrough from a team led by Jacob Covey, associate professor in the University of Chicago’s Pritzker School of Molecular Engineering and Department of Physics, turns helium-3’s low mass into a quantum resource.
